turns.content: For L_int=kappa psi-bar sigma_{mu nu} psi F^{mu nu} in four spacetime dimensions, state the mass dimensions of the Lagrangian density, psi, psi-bar, and sigma_{mu nu}; leave the field-strength dimension to be derived from its kinetic term.
How does the gauge kinetic term F^{mu nu}F_{mu nu} fix the mass dimension of the dynamical electromagnetic field strength?
Combine the field dimensions and explain why sigma_{mu nu}, being built from gamma-matrix commutators, contributes no mass dimension.
Compute the mass dimension of the composite operator psi-bar sigma_{mu nu} psi F^{mu nu}.
Require L_int to have dimension four and solve for the mass dimension of kappa.
Use four-dimensional power counting to classify the interaction as renormalizable or nonrenormalizable.
Check the dimension sum and relate the sign of [kappa] to its role in an effective-operator expansion.
